deployments_detail.use: Squish GUI test automation with built-in AI Assistant (Squish 9.1) to explain test failures and suggest test-case improvements

Qt AI Assistant: AI coding assistant embedded in Qt Creator IDE that auto-completes code, gives coding advice, generates unit tests and documentation for Qt/QML/C++. Connects to multiple LLMs. [OpenAI (GPT-5, GPT-4o, GPT-OSS 20B), Meta CodeLlama (fine-tuned), Ollama (local deployment)]
deployments_detail.value: GPT-5 achieves 59% success on QML100 benchmark, +12% over GPT-4o

deployments_detail.use: Qt AI Assistant Code Review Agent: Qt Group's first AI agent, reviews code for syntax, structural and common issues and suggests improvements, inside Qt AI Assistant. [Qt AI Assistant (multi-LLM)]

Qt Design Studio AI Assistant: agentic MCP-based assistant that generates and refactors QML UIs from natural-language prompts, reads project files, and generates QML from Figma designs via Figma Desktop MCP server. [Anthropic (Claude, incl. Opus), Google (Gemini Flash/Pro), OpenAI (GPT-4); Model Context Protocol; Figma Desktop MCP]

Squish AI Assistant: IDE extension for the Squish GUI test automation platform that refines test code, analyzes test failures, and troubleshoots Squish Runner/Server logs. [OpenAI (GPT-5/4.1/o4-mini), Mistral AI (Mistral Small 3.2, Magistral, Codestral 2), PrivateGPT (local)]

Squish Vision: AI-driven GUI testing using purpose-trained computer vision models to detect and interact with UI elements visually, independent of app framework or source code/IDs. [Qt Group (purpose-trained computer vision models)]

Qt Agentic Development Skills (agent-skills): packaged Qt-expert skills for AI coding agents that run deterministic linting (60+ rules), parallel sub-agents for code review, documentation generation, and QML coding best practices. [Anthropic (Claude Code / Claude marketplace), Microsoft (GitHub Copilot); tested with Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1 Pro]
deployments_detail.value: Improves QML code quality up to 11% (Claude Sonnet 4.6 from 64% to 75% on benchmark)

deployments_detail.use: CodeLlama-7B-QML: an LLM published by The Qt Company, fine-tuned (LoRA) from CodeLlama-7B on 5500+ human QML snippets for local Fill-In-The-Middle code completion of Qt 6 QML; distributed via Ollama. [Meta CodeLlama-7B (Llama 2) base; Qt Company fine-tune; Ollama distribution]
deployments_detail.value: 80% accuracy on QML100 FIM benchmark (vs GPT-4o 62%, Claude 3.7 Sonnet 76%)

deployments_detail.use: Axivion MCP: connects the Axivion static code analysis suite to AI coding agents/IDEs, letting agents trigger static analysis, explain defects in plain language, and suggest fixes using real project analysis data. [Model Context Protocol; GitHub Copilot Chat, VSCode integrations]
